hints.content:
The notation $f(-3)$ refers to the output of the function when the input is $x=-3$. If the point $(-3,b)$ is on the graph, then $f(-3)=b$.

We should look for the point on the graph whose $x$-coordinate is $-3$.

The point on the graph whose $x$-coordinate is $-3$ is the point $(-3,1)$.

**Therefore, $f(-3)=1$.**
